intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Beef-tenderloin and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Beef tenderloin itself is naturally gluten-free, but there are potential gluten risks from marinades, sauces, or cross-contamination during preparation. Care should be taken to ensure that no gluten-containing ingredients are used in the cooking process.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Beef-tenderloin can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: Can BiteRight confirm if Beef-tenderloin is gluten free?

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
faq.answer: Ask about shared equipment, sauces, marinades, and whether the kitchen has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.
